story.text: Every formula is born from a rigorous selection of precious actives and sensorial textures. We believe in honest, effective and respectful beauty, for rituals that feel good.

testimonials.quote_1: My skin has never looked so radiant. The texture is divine and the scent very delicate. I can't do without it!
testimonials.quote_2: A true luxury product: beautiful packaging, fast delivery and visible results from the first week.
testimonials.quote_3: I have sensitive skin and this is the first cream that doesn't cause any redness. Thank you!

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Can't find your answer? Our team is happy to help.
faq.question_1: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
faq.answer_1: Yes. Our formulas are tested under dermatological supervision and designed to respect even the most reactive skin.
faq.answer_2: Orders are prepared within 24 hours and delivered in 2 to 4 business days in mainland France.
faq.answer_3: You have 30 days to return an unopened product. Refunds are issued upon receipt.
faq.question_4: Are your products natural and vegan?
faq.answer_4: Our products contain up to 98% naturally derived ingredients and most of our formulas are vegan.
faq.question_5: How do I choose the right product for my skin?
faq.answer_5: Each product page lists the skin types it suits. You can also write to us: we will gladly advise you.
